messages:
sophia: Quick sync request from Product — they want a new Routing & Quotas dashboard in Console. Required signals: per-route p50/p95 latency, billed tokens, quota burn per API key (or aggregates), model-variant fallbacks count, and canary success rates.

ajay: Do we already export fallback events and per-key quota counters from runtime?

linda: We export request latency and model via statsd (redwood.request.latency, redwood.request.model). No per-key quota counters yet. We can emit redwood.quota.usage but can't tag by raw api_key due to cardinality; recommend hashing.

kevin: Cardinality is main problem. Proposal: 1) low-cardinality metrics for dashboards (per-route, per-tier) in Prom/Graphite with api_key hashed daily aggregates, and 2) full per-request events into Kafka (raw-requests) for BigQuery ETL/backfills and ad-hoc drilldowns.

sophia: Product needs near-real-time quota view (minutes lag ok) and historical views (30/90/365d options). Canary UX needs pass/fail per rollout id and % requests falling back.

linda: Exporter sketch (statsd-friendly):
redwood.requests.total:1|c|#model:{model},route:{route},status:{ok|err}
redwood.requests.fallback:1|c|#fallback_to:{model},route:{route}
redwood.quota.usage:tokens|g|#tier:{tier},route_group:{rg}
We will NOT attach api_key tag to metrics; instead include api_key_hash, rollout_id, latency_ms, tokens in raw Kafka events (schema v2).

ajay: So two pipelines: metrics for live UX and alerts, and analytics (kafka->bq) for high-cardinality/backfills. Sounds right?

kevin: Yes. ETL plan: daily job aggregating raw-requests into per-route/day aggregates (tokens, counts, fallback_count) in partitioned BQ table. One-off backfill for initial window. Estimates: 90d backfill ~8TB scanned (~$120) + some cluster time. 365d ~40TB (~$650).

sophia: Can the aggregation compute canary success rate? Define success = no fallback AND p95 latency < 500ms.

linda: We'll store timestamps in UTC and compute p50/p95 and fallback_rate by rollout_id in the ETL. Aggregation will produce rollout-level rows.

kevin: Retention: metrics fast 90d, compressed 1y; Kafka raw events 7d retention; aggregates in BQ 13 months, older archived to GCS as parquet every 6 months.

ajay: Product asked for ad-hoc API-key drilldowns for compliance — we'll rely on BQ with api_key_hash column and dataset ACLs for PII controls.

sophia: Backfill ask: Product wants 365d. Infra cost concern?

kevin: Recommend starting with 90d backfill to get dashboards live, then extend incrementally on explicit product approval.

linda: Implementation checklist:
- add redwood.requests.fallback and non-api-key redwood.quota.usage metric
- raw event v2 schema -> include rollout_id, api_key_hash, latency_ms, tokens
- kafka topic raw-requests retention 7d
- daily ETL -> partitioned BQ table
- initial backfill 90d, review before expanding

ajay: UX asks for canary widget (pass rate + failures), per-route quota burn-down sparkline, and alert rule: fallback_rate > 2% sustained 10m.

sophia: Ownership: eng-runtime emits metrics/events, eng-platform owns dashboards and alert rules.

ingest-bot: deploy scheduled: metrics-exporter v2 rollout to 30% hosts at 2026-03-20T02:00Z — monitor redwood.requests.fallback for spikes.

linda: I'll open the PR with exporter changes and raw schema spec; will tag data infra for ETL job.

ajay: Can we sync tomorrow 10:00 to lock retention/backfill and alert thresholds? @kevin @linda @sophia

kevin: +1

sophia: added to calendar. :calendar:
